主要内容: On January 7, 2019, Medallion Bank, a wholly owned subsidiary of Medallion Financial Corp., filed a registration statement on Form 10 relating to an offering of its Series F Fixed-to-Floating Rate Noncumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, par value $1.00 per share, with a liquidation preference of $25 per share. The preliminary offering circular includes a 'Recent Developments' section presenting preliminary, unaudited financial information for the Bank as of November 30, 2018, and its expectations for the month and year ended December 31, 2018. This information is not indicative of the Company's consolidated financial condition or results of operations for the same periods. The audit of the Company's consolidated financial statements for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2018, is in process but not yet complete. The filing contains forward-looking statements with inherent uncertainties.
